decisions.reason: The firm has sunk tooling and catalogue investment into this multi-model lever family, and two years on the market is still too short a specification cycle to judge it, so management will persist.
The multifunctional handle supports the publicly announced barrier-free one-stop system direction, so modest uptake can still be attributed to slow adoption by planners rather than to failure.
The line is embedded in the coordinated handle families and planning documentation, and having already pruned B and F, management will justify keeping its remaining 2023 launches.
The award-winning FSB 1289 collection has its own page and visible public promotion, so the strong commitment and positive result make withdrawal very unlikely.
